name: Serato DJ

store.notes:
•	AlphaTheta DJM-A7 support. Connect with a DJ Suite or iOS Outright license.
•	Updated performance pad mappings for the Pioneer DJ DJM-S5 and Numark Party Mix Pro.
•	Fixes for the Denon DJ PRIME 4, Rane SYSTEM ONE and Pioneer DJ PLX-CRSS12.
•	Better stability, memory and performance on devices with 4GB of RAM.

brief.headline: User dissatisfaction regarding pricing and feature paywalls
brief.happening: Users report frustration with subscription requirements and the cost of unlocking features previously owned. The feedback highlights concerns regarding the price point relative to competitors and the necessity of additional payments for hardware connection and library access.
brief.where_to_look: The subscription verification flow and feature entitlement logic.
brief.action: Review the feedback regarding feature accessibility for existing desktop users.
brief.reply: We hear your frustration regarding the subscription model for features you have previously purchased. We appreciate you sharing this feedback with us, as it helps us understand the impact on our long-term users. Please feel free to reach out to our support team to discuss your account details.

brief.headline: Feature gaps compared to competing DJ applications
brief.happening: Users report that the app lacks specific functionalities found in alternatives, such as HID mode support, custom controller mapping, and local MP3 library access. While a small minority of these reviews are positive, the majority express frustration regarding the current feature set and pricing structure.
brief.where_to_look: The local music library integration and hardware compatibility layers.
brief.action: Review the feature parity list against djay and Pioneer software.
brief.reply: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We understand your concerns regarding the current feature set and the transition to a subscription model. We value your long-term support of Serato and invite you to contact our support team to discuss your experience further.

brief.headline: Issues accessing local and iTunes music libraries
brief.happening: Users report being unable to access existing iTunes playlists and local MP3 files. Some users also noted that the app signs out of Apple Music after loading a track.
brief.where_to_look: The local file system integration and Apple Music library synchronization flow.
brief.action: Review the logs related to library permission requests and media player authentication.
brief.reply: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are having trouble accessing your iTunes library. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this specific issue further.
